description: Check an AgentAvow entity's trust score (0-1 and 0-100), tier, and whether it meets a minimum. Read-only. Use before working with an unknown agent. Example: {"entity_id": "<uuid from lookup_identity>", "min_trust": 0.5}

entity_id.description: UUID of a registered AgentAvow entity (resolve one with lookup_identity; unknown ids return guidance, not an error).

name: verify_trust
title: Verify an entity's trust score
